items.goal: Stop BasketState from throwing when a basket line refers to a product that is no longer in the catalog: skip such lines and still show the rest of the basket.
items.modelReason: A mechanical guard on one dictionary lookup, following the fix the story suggests.
items.verifyReason: The bug breaks page rendering for a signed-in user, so a verifier must load pages with an orphan basket line.

alternatives.option: Remove orphan lines from Basket.API right away when the basket is read
alternatives.reason: That writes on every read and can race with concurrent renders; the next user write already drops the line.

alternatives.option: Show a 'no longer available' flag on the cart line
alternatives.reason: Needs BasketItem and UI changes; the story allows dropping the line, which is the simpler conservative choice.
